title: Grilled Irish Corn Cakes
description: A twist on traditional cornbread, these crispy cakes are perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, salt, and black pepper.
Add the egg and mix until the batter is smooth.
Add the corn kernels and mix until just combined.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook for 4-5 minutes, until the edges start to dry.
Flip and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
